widgets_values: FLUX.3 Klein text to image: 1024x1024, 16 steps, CFG 1, Euler and the simple scheduler, as the model card and the reference code set them. The step-distilled model was trained for 4 to 16 steps: never go above 16, and pick a count that divides 10000 (4, 5, 8, 10 or 16) so the simple scheduler stays on the vendor's schedule. Keep Euler: the model reads its next sigma off the schedule, so a sampler that evaluates between steps leaves what it was distilled on. ComfyUI's native shift is the vendor's; add no shift node. Dimensions must be multiples of 16, and multiples of 32 keep both grid axes even. Plain Euler at CFG 1 never evaluates the empty negative. The vendor's prompt guide asks for a full caption of about 100 to 350 words: medium and style first, then scene, lighting and camera, then each subject with its colors, materials and place in the frame. Describe what is there, not what is absent, and put any text to render in double quotes. The sample prompt is shorter than that guide asks; write a full caption for your own renders. The vendor's own graphs can run an optional prompt upsampler, qwen3.5_9b_flux3_prompt_upsampler_int8_convrot.safetensors, which rewrites a short request into such a caption on the driver; its 9.7 GB is outside dgx-monarch's driver memory estimate. The stock Flux3 Layout Prompt node turns bounding boxes into prompt text. Either can feed CLIP Text Encode with no change to this graph. The INT8 ConvRot files pin an approximate attention kernel: single, cfg2 and dp2 ask for the Sol-Attn waiver, and uly2 drops the pin. This graph uses the BF16 files, which ask nothing. Auto picks Ulysses on a configured pair. In the 2026-10-15 hardware tests, uly2 renders of this graph matched stock ComfyUI on one GPU exactly; see docs/VALIDATION.md#evidence-flux-3-klein for the scope. Expects flux3_image_klein_sd_bf16.safetensors in models/diffusion_models, qwen3vl_4b_bf16.safetensors in models/text_encoders (CLIP type flux3) and flux2-vae.safetensors in models/vae; the vendor's vae/flux2-vae.safetensors holds the same weights in another key layout. Needs ComfyUI 0.41.0 or newer on the driver and every Worker. The FLUX.3 Image Klein weights are under the FLUX Kommunity License v1.0; read its terms before commercial use. The Qwen3-VL encoder is Apache-2.0. The first render of a new model runs the identity gate, comparing the mesh with a stock single-GPU load before producing pixels. Allow a few minutes for proof renders. Later renders of the same combination skip the gate. This graph is derived from the family adapter and stock node definitions, without a committed reference render. Check filenames and shapes against your artifacts before running it.

widgets_values: A color photograph of a white lighthouse on a granite headland at dusk. Waves break against the dark rocks below it, and the lamp glows amber against a deep blue sky with thin pink clouds near the horizon. A narrow stone path climbs from the lower left toward the tower. Wide angle, soft natural light, fine detail.
